jobs.title: Senior .NET, SQL & JavaScript Developer
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
🚀 Senior .NET Full-Stack Developer | Immediate Joiner

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Full-Stack Developer
with strong expertise in .NET, SQL Server, JavaScript, API development, CI/CD, and enterprise application security
.

Key Requirements

8–12+ years
of overall software development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core, MVC, and Web API
.
Advanced Microsoft SQL Server
expertise, including stored procedures, complex queries, views, triggers, indexing, execution plans, and performance tuning.
Strong knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3
.
Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as Angular, React, or similar
.
Strong experience in RESTful API development
and integration with ERP systems and third-party applications
.
Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps / GitHub, Git, and CI/CD pipelines
.
Experience managing deployments across Development, UAT/Staging, and Production
environments.
Good understanding of OWASP, secure coding practices, SQL Injection, XSS, and API security
.
Experience with unit/integration testing, debugging, performance profiling, and production defect resolution
.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Solution Architects, Business Analysts, System Administrators, and business stakeholders
.
Strong understanding of SOLID principles and enterprise application development
.

📌 Availability
Immediate Joiners are highly preferred.

If you meet the above requirements and are available to join immediately, please share your updated CV.

Please note:
Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
